name: Empowa
description_short: RWA housing finance for emerging markets.
description_long: Housing-finance platform for the ~85% of families in emerging markets excluded from traditional mortgages. Institutional capital in USD or local currency funds climate-smart, IFC EDGE-certified rent-to-own homes built by vetted in-country developers, while the blockchain community funds a separate over-collateralisation layer by buying Collateral NFTs whose proceeds are held as EMP. NFT holders receive EMP-denominated impact rewards tied to the specific housing cohort they funded, with rent payments and repayments auditable on-chain. Live portfolio in Mozambique reports 99% on-time rent payments and cost of finance cut from over 22% to about 10%.
